headline: Sensex, Nifty End Marginally Lower in Muhurat Trading Session, Snapping Seven-Day Winning Streak

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Sensex and Nifty edged marginally lower during the Diwali Muhurat trading session, breaking a seven-day rally.
Indian stocks ended in the red on Diwali for the first time in eight years.
Bharti Airtel and Infosys featured among the top losers during the special session.
Profit-booking occurred as Nifty closed below the 25,000 level.
whatHappening: BSE and NSE held the special Muhurat trading session on the occasion of Diwali Laxmi Pujan.
Indian stocks bucked global tech concerns to record their best weekly performance in six years prior to the session.
Market participants are looking ahead to key factors driving stock market action on Monday.
Nifty and Sensex recorded a minor dip during the limited trading window.
summary: Indian stock markets held the special Muhurat trading session on Diwali Laxmi Pujan, with Sensex and Nifty ending marginally lower and snapping a seven-day winning streak. Major benchmark index Nifty closed below 25,000 as Bharti Airtel and Infosys emerged as top losers. Despite the muted Muhurat performance, Indian equities posted their best weekly gains in six years.
